description:
What the planning scheme allows on this block: its zoning code and every
planning overlay that touches it (heritage, flood, bushfire, height and so
on, as published by the council).

Answers "can I build on it, and what is restricted". Development
applications in the surrounding area are a suburb-level call.

**Price: 8¢ per call.**
